paragraphs: I am a software engineer with over seven years of production Node.js experience, focused on backend architecture, AI integration, and agentic systems. I take problems end to end — from initial requirements and architecture through implementation, deployment, and release — selecting deterministic software, automation, or AI agents based on what the problem actually requires.

At VoiceDash, I owned backend services and Docker Compose multi-environment deployments for an AI dictation SaaS, managing staging and production releases, rollbacks, and operational risk across server and desktop clients. I also established agentic coding workflows for the development team and refactored AI-generated code toward a stable, maintainable architecture.

I am targeting Software Engineer, Backend Engineer, and AI or Agentic Systems Engineer roles in Canada, Ireland, the United Kingdom, the Netherlands, and Portugal. I bring practical experience taking systems from specification to production, with a focus on reliable software engineering and thoughtful AI integration.
